pages.text: Combat traits come in two kinds: $(bold)material default traits$() (granted by the core material itself, and they still trigger during technique and domain attacks) and $(bold)universal enhancement traits$() (attached through crystals / rituals).$(br2)$(bold)Material default traits$():$(li)$(l:trait_child_of_the_stars)Child of the Stars$() (Ashen Ink): final damage ×2^level$(li)$(l:trait_cosmic_order_voice)Voice of the Celestial Order$() (Gheloth Remains): on hit: Slowness / Blindness$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_fire)Dragonfire$() (Dragonsteel Fire): on hit: explodes and ignites$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_ice)Dragonsteel Ice$() (Dragonsteel Ice): on hit: freezes$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_lightning)Dragonbolt$() (Dragonsteel Lightning): on hit: lightning strikes and disarms$(li)$(l:trait_dreadsteel)Dread$() (Dreadsteel): piercing sword aura + Weakness / Blindness / Wither$(li)$(l:trait_hastur_malice)Hastur's Malice$() (Hastur's Malice): on hit: pulls targets into a damaging wind field$(li)$(l:trait_charm)Charm$() (Life Impulse): on hit: charms, preventing the target from attacking$(li)$(l:trait_dragonbone)Bearer$() (Dragonbone): +1 level to dragon-steel traits$(li)$(l:trait_dragon_blood_tank)Dragon Blood Tank$() (Dragonbone): stores three kinds of dragon blood$(li)$(l:trait_unbreakable)Unbreakable$() (Durandal): tools never take damage$(li)$(l:trait_cold_blooded)Cold-Blooded$() (Formless Ice): appends Ice spell damage after each hit$(li)$(l:trait_endless_cold_wind)Endless Cold Wind$() (Formless Ice): +50% Ice spell power while held$(li)$(l:trait_blazing)Blazing$() (Pyrium): chance to ignite + appended Fire spell damage$(li)$(l:trait_holy_war_relic)Holy War Relic$() (Pyrium): +1 upgrade, +1 defense, +2 ability slots$(li)$(l:trait_magic_conduction)Magic Conduction$() (Arcane Iron): reduces magic damage, stacks per piece$(li)$(l:trait_focus)Focus$() (Mithril): casting cannot be interrupted, +5% cast speed per level$(li)$(l:trait_spell_break)Spell Break$() (Mithril): comes with level 1 Counterspell

$(bold)Universal enhancement traits$():$(li)$(l:trait_nyarlathotep_desire)Nyarlathotep's Desire$(): +1 ability slot per level$(li)$(l:trait_yog_sothoth_gift)Yog-Sothoth's Gift$(): +500% experience$(li)$(l:trait_black_flash)Black Flash$(): chance to erupt with massive damage$(li)$(l:trait_west_tiger)West Tiger$(): increases the Black Flash trigger rate$(li)$(l:trait_lucky_drop)Lucky Drop$(): extra loot drops$(li)$(l:trait_gorgon_immunity)Mind's Eye$(): immune to petrifying gaze$(li)$(l:trait_fus_ro_dah)Fus-Ro-Dah$(): knockback on hit$(li)$(l:trait_ghost_clearing)Atheist$(): clears ghosts$(li)$(l:trait_dragon_blood_infusion)Dragon Blood Infusion$(): dragon blood applies status effects$(li)$(l:trait_chaos_butterfly)Chaos Butterfly$(): the war scythe's Fever mechanic$(li)$(l:trait_quantum_bag)Quantum Bag$(): a pocket dimension you carry along$(br2)$(bold)Armor-exclusive traits$() (not applicable to cores):$(li)$(l:trait_star_child_armor)Child of the Stars (Armor)$()$(li)$(l:trait_dragonsteel_fire_armor)Fire Dragon Scales$() / $(l:trait_dragonsteel_ice_armor)Ice Dragon Scales$() / $(l:trait_dragonsteel_lightning_armor)Lightning Dragon Scales$()$(li)$(l:trait_dreadsteel_armor)Dreadsteel Armament$(li)$(l:trait_ancient_sanctuary)Ancient Sanctuary$() (Pyrium): 5% damage reduction per piece; +50% Fire spell power$()
